text:
mike: Quick async — starting canary ramp for Feature-X (slice B) at 11:00 PT. Short check: obs/alerts, oncall coverage, rollback plan, and any CRs blocking the rollout? TL;DR please.

olivia: On schedule. FF flag is staged in prod, param: 5% -> 20% over 2h (increments: 5, 10, 20). Dashboard link posted to #observability. No legal/reg concerns. @david you OK for oncall overlap? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

david: I can cover the first hour (11:00-11:59). I'll be OOO 11:30-12:30 but handed pager to lena. Alerts to watch: error-rate > 0.5% (5m), p95 latency > 300ms. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary.

lena: Acks. Runbook short snippet: if error spike -> flip flag to off and open incident channel. Flip command is:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/flags/feature-x/disable
```
I tested the script in staging just now.

anika: Canary image pushed, infra probes all green. One outstanding code review on rollout-controller: PR #4321 — small goroutine race fix. @mike can you approve? Otherwise safe to proceed.

mike: Approving PR #4321 now. Also confirm routing fallback: if capacity constrained, will requests fall back to distil variant? current routing policy shows `fallback:model-distil`.

ravi: Confirmed. Fallback to `model-distil-quant` is enabled for this slice. Note: quality drop on long conversations (see evals dashboard), but latency/cost tradeoff is acceptable for the ramp. We'll monitor BLEU/ROUGE-like checks for regression.

grace: I'll monitor token-cost deltas from Optimize. Please ping if cost > +15% vs baseline.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollout_id=r-208765-17-1 status=started target=5% initiated_by=@mike

david: Observability note — saw a small 502 blip at 11:07 (canary), spike to 0.4% error for 2 mins, stabilized by 11:09. No rollback. Investigating logs: `upstream reset` on a single host, drained and replaced automatically.

mike: Update: ramped to 10% at 11:25, then to 20% at 12:55. No customer-facing issues reported. If anyone sees sustained errors, flip flag and ping #eng-oncall. Thanks team :rocket:

lena: Leaving watch on alerts til 13:30 PT. I have the rollback command ready.

anika: Merging follow-up cleanup PRs now. Will post post-mortem template if anything unusual.

grace: Cost delta at 12:10 was +6% (within expected). Will report if trending upward.

mike: Closing thread — everything looks healthy so far. Notes for post-rollout: file perf snippets and token-cost summary to the release doc.
